candidates.question: What defines a "group of parentheses" in terms of start and end markers?
candidates.answer: A group starts where the running depth goes from 0 to 1 (an opening '(') and ends where the depth returns to 0 (the matching ')'); everything in between, however deeply nested, belongs to that one group.
